<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Страница-1" id="zJdzNPa6uHMzNS-lk9RP"> <mxGraphModel dx="5150" dy="3290" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor T as Terminal Simulator
 participant GW as Gateway
 participant SW as Switch
 participant AUTH as Authorization
 participant CMS as Card Management
 participant BIN as Bin Lookup
 participant RMQ as RabbitMQ
 participant LOG as Logger
 participant NS as Notification Service

 T->>GW: POST /api/transactions (auth request)
 GW->>GW: validate request
 GW->>SW: forward transaction
 SW->>SW: extract BIN, route to issuer
 SW->>AUTH: POST /api/internal/authorize (AuthorizationRequest + issuerId)
 AUTH->>BIN: GET /api/bin/{bin} (enrich issuerId)
 BIN-->>AUTH: BinLookupResponse {issuerId, ...}
 AUTH->>CMS: GET /api/cards/{pan}
 CMS-->>AUTH: Card {id, status, limits, ...}
 AUTH->>AUTH: check status, expiry, limits, balance
 alt approved
 AUTH->>CMS: POST /api/cards/{pan}/reserve {amount, rrn}
 CMS-->>AUTH: OK
 CMS-->>RMQ: Publish card event (outbox)
 AUTH->>AUTH: generate RRN, authCode
 AUTH-->>SW: AuthResponse {approved, rrn, authCode}
 else declined
 AUTH-->>SW: AuthResponse {declined, reason}
 else declined: карта BLOCKED [ДОБАВЛЕНО]
 rect rgb(200, 240, 200)
 Note over AUTH: card.status == BLOCKED → DeclineOutcome.CARD_BLOCKED
 AUTH-->>SW: AuthResponse {declined, reason CARD_BLOCKED, responseCode 05} (HTTP 403)
 end
 end
 SW->>RMQ: Publish Transaction (async)
 alt Publisher Confirm: ack ≤ 2 с [ДОБАВЛЕНО]
 rect rgb(200, 240, 200)
 RMQ-->>SW: basic.ack → ConfirmCallback(correlationData, ack=true)
 end
 SW-->>GW: TransactionResponse
 GW-->>T: HTTP 200 {approved|declined, ...}
 RMQ-->>LOG: Consume Transaction
 LOG->>LOG: Save to DB
 RMQ-->>NS: Consume card event
 NS->>NS: Save notification
 else nack или нет ack за 2 с [ДОБАВЛЕНО]
 rect rgb(200, 240, 200)
 RMQ--xSW: basic.nack → ConfirmCallback(correlationData, ack=false) / confirm timeout 2s
 alt Сценарий 3: reversal — транзакция APPROVED
 SW->>AUTH: POST /api/internal/rollback (RollbackRequest {rrn, pan, amount}, reversal mti \"0400\")
 AUTH->>CMS: POST /api/cards/{pan}/rollback {amount, rrn}
 CMS->>CMS: findByRrnAndPanForUpdate(rrn, pan)
 CMS->>CMS: reservation RESERVED → ROLLED_BACK, availableBalance += amount
 CMS-->>AUTH: OK
 CMS-)RMQ: Publish card event (outbox)
 AUTH->>AUTH: release limit_usage {pan, amount}
 AUTH-->>SW: RollbackResponse {approved}
 SW-->>GW: TransactionResponse {declined, responseCode 96}
 GW-->>T: HTTP 200 {declined, responseCode 96}
 RMQ-)NS: Consume card event
 NS->>NS: Save notification
 else транзакция DECLINED
 SW-->>GW: TransactionResponse {declined, reason}
 GW-->>T: HTTP 200 {declined, ...}
 end
 end
 end
 end
",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
